name: XR Eye Trainer
summary:
Welcome to XR Eye Trainer — a new way to rest, focus, and strengthen your eyes through immersive Mixed Reality routines.

Early Access version — some features are still in development. New exercises, voice guidance, and visual updates will be added in upcoming releases.

In this version, you can explore a core set of eye-training routines designed to improve focus flexibility, relieve tension, and support healthy vision.

Build a healthy eye-movement habit in Mixed Reality
